claims.claim_text: Article: a foreign architect is not Filipino, not registered/licensed in the Philippines, and is duly registered/licensed in the home country.

source_support.quoted_pdf_excerpt: not a Filipino citizen nor an Architect registered and licensed in the Philippines ... duly registered and licensed in his/her home country.

claims.claim_text: Article: Filipino counterpart means the local Philippine architect, partnership, or corporation that must work in association with the foreign architect or entity on Philippine soil.

source_support.quoted_pdf_excerpt: local Philippine architect, partnership or corporation that must work in association with a foreign architect ... on a project on Philippine soil.

claims.claim_text: Article and question c348de7a-021d-4ff6-9c91-c9673fb255f6: Section 38 requires a special/temporary permit from the Board, subject to Commission approval, before assuming duties.

source_support.quoted_pdf_excerpt: before assuming the duties, functions and responsibilities ... secure a special/temporary permit from the Board subject to approval of the Commission.

claims.claim_text: Article: a foreign person or firm whose name appears with architect/design consultant titles on plans, specifications, permits, advertisements, or billboards is deemed practicing architecture in the Philippines.

source_support.quoted_pdf_excerpt: whose name or company name ... appears on architectural plans ... shall be deemed practicing architecture in the Philippines.

claims.claim_text: Article and question edit 0161cbf0-c8cc-4130-92af-aa9d72060818: Section 36 prohibits unregistered fee collection for architectural services except as an employee representative of a Registered Architect.

source_support.quoted_pdf_excerpt: unlawful for any unregistered person to collect a fee for architectural services except as an employee.

claims.claim_text: Questions ce906996-8079-4d29-be28-ff0467120340 and 39ca179b-d99c-4af0-8dc9-ea438d4895e2: Section 27 reciprocity requires foreign-country admission of Filipino citizens without restriction or on strict and absolute equality after examination.

source_support.quoted_pdf_excerpt: admits citizens of the Philippines to the practice of the same profession without restriction ... strict and absolute equality.

claims.claim_text: Question 1c94b42d-f325-4780-8ee6-4bb31ffae4ef and question edit dffb3280-babd-44e7-869c-c9de9b42335c: Temporary/Special Permit is issued to an individual foreign architect and is project-limited.

source_support.source_locator: PRBoA Resolution No. 03 s.2008, Temporary/Special Permit definition
source_support.quoted_pdf_excerpt: can only be issued to an individual foreign architect ... not to foreign architectural firms.

claims.claim_text: Question edit dffb3280-babd-44e7-869c-c9de9b42335c: a Temporary/Special Permit is for one project alone.

source_support.quoted_pdf_excerpt: issued to a foreign architect for one (1) project alone.

claims.claim_text: Questions c17e40b2-9252-4ee3-8c91-8b348746079a and 9e07d6a6-a5bf-4615-8aac-b58634d3584c: a foreign architect holding a Temporary/Special Permit cannot act as Architect-of-record; the role is reserved to the Filipino counterpart.

source_support.quoted_pdf_excerpt: cannot act as the Architect-of-record (Aor), as this position is reserved solely for the Filipino counterpart.

claims.claim_text: Question edit edbae089-2b69-424c-8abd-4082fd647dcf: the PRBoA TSP application form requests passport number/issuing country-state and architect registration details.

source_support.quoted_pdf_excerpt: Passport Number & Issuing Country/state ... Details of Registration of Architect.
